settings.title: Details
settings.content: A slim, tapered cut with belt loops at the waist. Explore the waist, leg and hem in the close-up views below.

settings.title: Shipping
settings.content_intl:
Orders placed before 4pm dispatch from Brisbane the same afternoon.

  • Singapore: 4 to 6 days. Free standard shipping over S$250.
  • United Kingdom: 5 to 8 days. Free standard shipping over £65.
  • Europe: 6 to 9 days.

Every international order ships DDP. Duties and import taxes are calculated and paid at checkout, so nothing is owed on arrival.
settings.content:
Orders placed before 4pm dispatch from Brisbane the same afternoon.

  • Australia: 2 to 4 days. Free standard shipping over $100, free express over $200.
  • New Zealand: 2 to 4 days. Free priority express over NZ$160.

Tracked door to door on every order.

settings.content_intl:

settings.question: How do they fit?
settings.answer: A slim cut through the leg with a tapered ankle. Start with your usual waist and use Find my size to account for your build and preferred fit. The size guide lists waist and inside-leg measurements.

settings.question: Are they comfortable for all day wear?
settings.answer:
A slim silhouette, from the waist through the leg. Pair with a fitted shirt or polo.

Use the size guide to compare measurements before choosing.

settings.question: What should I pair them with?
settings.answer: A polo and loafers for a long lunch. A slim fit shirt for the office. A tee and clean sneakers on the weekend. The Luxe Chino is the piece everything else in your wardrobe is built around.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: 44-day returns and exchanges. Free return postage for Australia and New Zealand; customers elsewhere cover return postage. Start through our returns portal.

settings.question: When will they arrive?
settings.answer: Delivery options and an estimated arrival are shown at checkout for your address. Check the shipping information beside the size selector for your region.
